title: Traffic volume (AADT)
description: Average annual daily traffic, in vehicles per day, on each road segment with a count. Wider lines are higher road classes.

source.name: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS) 2024
source.citation: Federal Highway Administration, Highway Performance Monitoring System 2024, via the BTS National Transportation Atlas Database

license: Public domain (U.S. Government work; NTAD "available for unrestricted public use"). Credit FHWA and BTS.
universe: road segments with a reported AADT

measure.select: SELECT aadt, f_system, through_lanes, aadt_single_unit, aadt_combination, CASE routesigning WHEN 2 THEN 'Interstate' WHEN 5 THEN 'Interstate' WHEN 3 THEN 'US highway' WHEN 4 THEN 'State highway' WHEN 6 THEN 'County road' ELSE 'City or local road' END AS road_type, TRIM(CASE routesigning WHEN 2 THEN 'I-' || CASE WHEN TRIM(routename) GLOB '[0-9]*' AND LENGTH(TRIM(routename)) <= 5 THEN TRIM(routename) ELSE routenumber END WHEN 5 THEN 'I-' || routenumber || ' Business' WHEN 3 THEN 'US ' || routenumber WHEN 4 THEN '{state} ' || routenumber WHEN 6 THEN 'County Rd ' || routenumber ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN routesigning IN (2,3,4,6) THEN CASE routequalifier WHEN 2 THEN ' Alternate' WHEN 3 THEN ' Business' WHEN 4 THEN ' Bypass' WHEN 5 THEN ' Spur' WHEN 6 THEN ' Loop' WHEN 9 THEN ' Truck' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END) AS route, CASE WHEN routesigning IN (2,5) THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(routename), '') END AS street, Shape FROM {layer} WHERE aadt > 0

coverageNote: Segments are as states report them to FHWA; not every local road has a count. Not for navigation.

facets.label: Road type
facets.explainer: Which route sign the road carries. Turn types off to focus on, say, just Interstates and U.S. highways.

values.label: Interstate
values.description: The Interstate Highway System, including Interstate business loops.

values.label: U.S. highway
values.description: Numbered U.S. routes such as US 52.

values.label: State highway
values.description: Routes numbered by the state, such as MN 55.

values.label: City or local road
values.description: Roads with only a street name, including busy city arterials.

facets.label: Functional class
facets.explainer: The job a road does, from long-distance travel down to reaching your front door. It sets line width on the map.

values.label: Freeway or expressway
values.description: Other limited-access highways, with ramps instead of intersections.

values.label: Principal arterial
values.description: Major roads connecting cities, and the main corridors within them.

values.label: Minor arterial
values.description: Roads linking neighborhoods and towns to principal arterials.

values.label: Major collector
values.description: Gather traffic from local roads in towns and rural areas.

values.label: Local road
values.description: Streets that mainly provide access to homes and businesses.
